title: Improve dropdown styling and search icons
summary:
**Summary:**

Design-tweak session on **Meridian** (a browser new-tab extension) with dual synced copies: root (`meridian.css/html/js`, `components/*.js`) and `meridian-extension/`. Every change must be mirrored to both; tests in `tests/browserSearchScopes.test.mjs` (run via `node --test`).

**User is blunt/profane when I err** — key lessons: don't branch when committing (commit to `main`), don't guess/wing designs, follow stated spec exactly, verify both copies stay in sync (a missed extension-copy export rename blanked the whole page once).

**Committed to main:** `9ea1f93` scoped omni-search + auto-accent; `ac57188` unified `SearchPopup.js` shell (bookmarks/history/search/settings all use it); `74ecc02` settings reorg with SVG diagram card-grids (new-tab behavior, theme sun/moon/auto, provider favicons).

**Auto-accent engine** (`SettingsPanel.js`): derives `--accent-hue` from background's dominant color (saturation-weighted histogram for images), WCAG contrast solver anchored to `--surface`, plus `--on-bg` tokens for lane-header legibility. Light `--surface` = `#eaeaea`.

**Just implemented (uncommitted):** placeholder "Search anything…", removed "Add a new group" button, context-menu suppresses lightbox, click-to-rename lane titles, "Move to new group" creates+inline-renames, clickable color-dot palette. Lane header alignment fixed via `translateY(1px)` on icons — **but user's latest message: the tab-count number now sits too high** and needs fixing next.
